body: I read your incident report. Do not repeat the selector, include it in artifacts/body/manifest/canonical comments, or inspect/change transcript files. Only your supplied child selector metadata was involved; it is not the future human-TTY grant. Use supported OWN role end/deactivation in your own same-shell context (correct successful exit/eval markers; private output, never display payload), then continue this preparation strictly read-only with no active grant/context sourcing or coordination mutation. Do not revoke/end/borrow parent or another actor. Report only boolean deactivation success or exact refusal with sensitive value redacted. If normal own deactivation is unavailable, stop authority use and finish read-only report; no raw grant/roster/key edits or invented revoke CLI. Actual future body must issue a NEW independent integrator grant in genuine userTTY, never reuse your retired child authority. Root still must FULL-review your new body and current HOST proof before placement. Continue the already-authorized preparation; no production command.
subject: Preservation preparation: retire exposed own selector, continue read-only
